textBindings.from: I’m Sourabh, a frontend developer with 2+ years of experience crafting responsive, performant web applications. Specializing in React, Next.js, and modern CSS, I turn complex problems into clean, intuitive interfaces. I care deeply about the details — from pixel-perfect layouts to silky-smooth animations.

I’m currently exploring AI automation and automated image-generation pipelines for clothing brands, helping create catalogue visuals without manual photoshoots and with the potential to reduce production costs by up to 90%. I’m also deepening my backend skills with the goal of becoming a full-stack developer.
